title: Magical Maze: Heart and Key Quest
description: In this fantasy adventure game, the player is trapped in a cursed forest and must complete various missions to return to the real world. The player needs to collect hearts, solve puzzles, pass through moving platforms, and avoid enemies while exploring the environment. By overcoming these challenges, the player gradually breaks the curse, restores harmony to the forest, and defeats the witch’s evil magic.

title: Merlin’s Curse
description:
Merlin’s Curse is a fantasy action-adventure game that mixes puzzle-solving, fighting, and story exploration. The player controls Merlin, a boy who is trapped by a curse and guided by a mysterious woman. To escape, he must explore magical worlds, solve puzzles, and use different elemental powers to fight enemies and guardians.

As the story continues, Merlin learns that the woman helping him is hiding a dark secret. What starts as a journey for freedom turns into a battle against betrayal and fate. The game focuses on emotional storytelling, beautiful environments, and fun gameplay that combines thinking, exploration, and action.

title: Battle Banner
description:
Battle Banner is a fast-paced 3D competitive First Person Shooter (FPS) game set in a post-apocalyptic urban battlefield. Players are divided into two small teams, each protecting their own banner while trying to steal the enemy’s banner and return it to their base.

Unlike traditional FPS games, Battle Banner emphasizes tactical movement, quick decision-making, and teamwork rather than shooting alone. With short and intense matches designed for 1–4 players per team, the game encourages cooperation, strategy, and communication. Through exciting gameplay, players learn the importance of teamwork, timing, and collaboration while enjoying a fun and competitive experience.

title: Lost Era: Crystal Hunt Trailer
description:
Lost Era: Crystal Hunt is a 3D multiplayer PvE game with a Historical Time Travel theme. The game places players in different historical eras where they must work together to collect scattered energy crystals while avoiding guardians without harming them.

After all crystals are collected, a countdown begins and alien enemies are released, forcing players to escape back to their spaceship before time runs out. The game emphasizes teamwork, critical thinking, and non-violent problem-solving through cooperative gameplay.

title: Secret of the Blooded Town (FYP)
description:
Secret of the Blooded Town is an adventure narrative game developed as a Final Year Project that explores narrative design and storytelling structures in games. Set in a mysterious coastal town, the player takes on the role of an investigator tasked with uncovering hidden truths behind a murder case.

The project focuses on studying how different narrative structures influence player understanding, immersion, and engagement. Through environmental storytelling, dialogue, and clue-based investigation, the game examines how narrative presentation affects the way players interpret story events and make connections within the game world.

title: Lightbound
description:
Lightbound is a puzzle-adventure experience set in a mysterious otherworld. After a strange accident, the player is transformed into a glowing Seeker Orb and trapped in an unfamiliar environment.

To return to the real world, the player must explore the surroundings, solve puzzles, complete objectives, and carefully avoid enemies. Through observation, logic, and strategic movement, the player gradually uncovers the path to escape.

title: The Last Light of Divinity
description:
The Last Night of Divinity is a narrative-driven fantasy project set in a world where Gods, Humans, and Monsters coexist in a fragile balance. Each race is sustained by a Core Element, a powerful source of energy meant to coexist rather than dominate. For centuries, the Gods acted as overseers of this balance, but as Humans and Monsters grow independent of divine power, the Gods begin to fear the loss of their supremacy.

As divine fear turns into control, the Gods manipulate the world by stealing the Monster Core and forcing the Monsters to take the Human Core, pushing the balance toward collapse. The player takes on the role of a Human Guardian, tasked with protecting humanity, uncovering the truth behind divine manipulation, and fighting to restore a world where coexistence is chosen over domination.

title: Village of the Spider Curse (Unity)
description: Once a peaceful village, now abandoned and overrun by spiders. The streets and buildings are slowly consumed as a mysterious spider entity takes control, turning the village into a dangerous and cursed territory.

title: The Secret Under the Town (Unity)
description: At first glance, the village lives in peace and normality. However, hidden within a nearby cave lies a monstrous spider, quietly growing in power and waiting for the moment to emerge.

title: The Celestial Realm (Unreal Engine)
description: A divine kingdom floating above the mortal world, where gods reside and oversee the balance of all races. Majestic architecture and sacred energy reflect the authority, order, and power of the god race.

title: AR Business Card
description: An AR interactive business card created with Unity and Vuforia. Scanning the card reveals a 3D character and buttons that display personal information, projects, and hobbies in a modern and engaging way.

title: AR Greeting Card
description: An AR Christmas greeting card made with Unity and Vuforia. Scanning the card shows a festive 3D scene with interactive effects like snow, music, and photo capture for a joyful experience.

title: AR Storybook – The Three Little Pigs
description: This AR interactive storybook, developed using Unity and Vuforia, is designed for children aged 7 to 12 and is based on The Three Little Pigs. The storybook includes interactive mini-games such as building houses, facing the wolf, and answering quiz questions, allowing children to learn moral values through fun and engaging gameplay.

title: Escape the Room
description: Escape the Room is a puzzle-based game where players must explore the environment, find hidden clues, and solve puzzles to unlock the door and escape. The game challenges players’ observation skills, logic, and problem-solving abilities through immersive and interactive gameplay.

title: Survival Island
description: Survival Island is an educational survival game where players learn basic survival knowledge through gameplay. The story begins with a shipwreck, leaving the player stranded on an unknown island with limited resources. Players must collect food and water, manage hunger and thirst, and learn survival skills such as identifying edible resources and boiling seawater. After completing key tasks, players travel to a larger island with richer resources, new animals, and potential dangers like poisonous plants. By exploring, learning, and making the right decisions, players complete the final mission and escape the island safely.

title: Emo
description: Lily is a talented girl who grows up under extreme academic pressure from her parents. Overwhelmed by stress and emotional pain, she begins to lose herself and faces a dark inner struggle. Trapped between reality and her unconscious mind, Lily reaches a breaking point that leads to a life-changing moment.

title: Meowtivation Journey
description: This story follows Lily, a young girl who wakes up in a hospital after a suicide attempt. She is drawn into a mysterious Cat Kingdom by a black cat, where she experiences warmth, joy, and companionship. When darkness from her past and inner pain returns, Lily is forced to confront her depression. With the support of the cats, she finds the courage to accept herself and regain hope. She later wakes up in the hospital, unsure whether the Cat Kingdom was real or a dream, but carrying newfound strength and hope in her heart.

title: Human and Animal Walk and Run Cycle
The Alley Fight
description:
This animation tells the story of a young man and his sick mother living in poverty in a dark cyberpunk alley. When a violent man arrives to demand protection money, the young man is forced into a fight he is unlikely to win. Despite his weakness, he chooses to stand and protect his mother and their home. At the moment of defeat, his mother bravely intervenes with an old gun, revealing her love, strength, and courage despite her illness.
All characters in this animation were fully modeled by our team, highlighting both technical modeling skills and emotional storytelling through animation.

title: Love Story
description:
Love Story is a short film about a boy who gathers the courage to confess his feelings to a girl he likes. The narrative follows his emotional journey from nervous anticipation and fear of rejection to moments of happiness and shy relief.

The film applies basic cinematic shooting techniques to enhance storytelling, including establishing shots to set the mood, close-up shots to emphasize emotions, and slow pan shots to create a gentle, romantic atmosphere. Camera movement and framing are used intentionally to guide the audience’s focus and reflect the character’s inner feelings throughout the story.

title: Batu Nisan: The Last Carver
description: Batu Nisan: The Last Carver is a documentary about the disappearing art of traditional tombstone carving. It follows Mr. Kuah, a Chinese craftsman who creates tombstones for Malay and Indian communities, highlighting the complex carving process, his unique workplace, and the importance of preserving this fading cultural heritage.

title: HAPPY Birthday?
description: “HAPPY Birthday?” is a short film that takes place during an online group meeting. While discussing an assignment, strange moments begin to occur as voices from the iPad blur the line between reality and imagination. In the end, the tension is revealed to be part of a carefully planned birthday surprise prepared by her teammates outside the door.

title: 10 Types of DMT Student Life
description: “10 Types of DMT Student Life” is a creative re-dubbing project where existing movie scenes are trimmed and re-edited, then combined with original voice-over to represent different types of Digital Media Technology students. Through humor and relatable situations, the project portrays everyday student life, including assignments, deadlines, group work, stress, creativity, and personal habits. By transforming familiar film moments into student narratives, the work reflects shared experiences and personalities commonly seen in DMT student life.

title: Visual Soundscape – Graduation Reflection
description:
This project is an audio narrative inspired by a graduation moment, symbolizing the completion of an important life chapter. Through layered environmental sounds and music, I portray a four-year journey filled with curiosity, stress, growth, and reflection. Cheerful sounds such as birds chirping and lively campus chatter represent the excitement of the first day, while lighter background music reinforces her enthusiasm.

As the journey progresses, sounds like keyboard typing, paper flipping, and clock ticking introduce academic pressure, accompanied by a more tense musical tone. The piece concludes with a softer, reflective atmosphere, highlighting her realization of how quickly time has passed and how much she has grown. The project demonstrates how sound design alone can communicate emotional storytelling.

title: Fitness Mobile Application - Boostify
description: A mobile health and fitness application designed to help users manage their daily wellness routines efficiently. The app enables users to schedule fitness classes, track calorie intake and calories burned, monitor workout performance, and engage with a community feed for motivation and support.

title: Fitness Web Application - Boostify
description: A web-based health and fitness platform that enables users to schedule classes, track calorie intake and calories burned, and engage with a community feed to support their fitness journey.

title: IG Reels/Story
description: This project showcases my video editing and social media content creation work, including promotional videos, short-form content, and event publicity materials.
